name: diag_train_look_first_unit_black_guard_plan_01
command:
"""One exact G01 opening-black proof and identity-only retry plan; no submit.

Execute this self-recording inline producer directly via original run_logged,
only after canonical710105 accounting has sealed. Uses the reviewed native PNG chain.
"""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import shlex
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from src.tools import pbs_black_retry as b

r = Path.cwd().resolve()
require = b.require
name = 'diag_train_look_first_unit_black_guard_plan_01'
job = '710105.hopper-m-02'
parent_name = 'gen_train_look_first_unit_01'
next_name = 'gen_train_look_first_unit_01_retry1'
folder = r / 'logs/pbs/gen_train_look_first_unit_01-20261110T090456Z-e9bc210a'
account_name = 'g01_train_look_first_unit_final_accounting_02'
old_plan = {'file': 'configs/gen_train_look_first_unit_01_quota.json',
            'sha256': 'da366045a7b5cb060f85210852e53286b80b09f4417d00f960f68ce768427cd2'}


def ref(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    return {'file': str(path.relative_to(r)), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}


def load(filename):
    rr = ref(r / filename)
    data, _ = b.logged(r, rr)
    return data, dict(rr, metrics_sha256=data['_meta']['metrics_sha256'])


parent, pref = load('results/' + parent_name + '.json')
gate_name = parent_name + '_j710105_hopper_m_02_gate'
gate, gref = load('results/' + gate_name + '.json')
account, aref = load('results/' + account_name + '.json')
pp, sp, rp = (folder / p for p in ('payload.json', 'job.pbs', 'submission.json'))
payload, receipt = json.loads(pp.read_bytes()), json.loads(rp.read_bytes())
expected = ['python3', '-u', '-m', 'src.tools.g01_collect_parallel', '--name', parent_name,
    '--scenes', 'FloorPlan315', '--concurrency', '6', '--benchmark-source',
    'results/gen_train_concurrency_s15_02.json', '--timeout-seconds', '1600', '--partition', 'train',
    '--quota-plan', old_plan['file'], '--quota-plan-sha256', old_plan['sha256'],
    '--nearby-physics', '--sample-rejected-raw']
require(payload['repo'] == str(r) and payload['name'] == parent_name and payload['command'] == expected
    and payload['dry_run'] is False and payload['task_id'] == 'T01' and payload['budget_group'] == 'G01'
    and payload['budget_batch'] == 't00b_t01_20261108' and payload['queue'] == 'autox'
    and payload['requested_host'] is None and payload['requested_gpu_count'] == 1
    and payload['requested_wall_seconds'] == 1630, 'Original exact G01 payload differs')
require(pp.stat().st_mode & 0o222 == sp.stat().st_mode & 0o222 == 0
    and receipt['returncode'] == 0 and receipt['stdout'].strip() == job and not receipt['stderr'],
    'Original immutable submission or receipt differs')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('original_submit_for_train_look_guard', r / 'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py')
phase = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(phase)
require(sp.read_text() == phase.render_job_script((r / 'scripts/pbs/job_1gpu.pbs').read_text(), 1, pp, None),
        'Original PBS script differs from original one-GPU template')
require(account['_meta']['command'] == ['python3', 'src/tools/pbs_usage.py', '--name', account_name, job],
        'Canonical accounting was not the exact original script')
final = phase._final_accounting(r, {job}, paths=[r / aref['file']])
require(job in final, 'Original canonical accounting missing')
rows = [v for v in account['config']['jobs'] if v['job_id'] == job]
require(len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]['qstat_exit'] == 0, 'Canonical job ambiguous')
f = rows[0]['fields']
require(f.get('job_state') == 'F' and f.get('Exit_status') == '86' and f.get('run_count') == '1'
    and f.get('project') == 'CFP04-SF-125' and f.get('Job_Owner', '').split('@')[0] == 'e1583364'
    and f.get('Resource_List.ngpus') == '1' and f.get('Resource_List.ncpus') == '12'
    and f.get('Resource_List.walltime') == '00:27:10' and f.get('queue') == 'smallx'
    and 'PBS_O_QUEUE=autox' in f.get('Variable_List', '')
    and shlex.split(f['Submit_arguments']) == receipt['command'][1:]
    and f['Output_Path'].split(':', 1)[1] == str(folder / 'pbs.out'), 'Canonical allocation differs')
c, pm = parent['config'], parent['metrics']
gc, gm = gate['config'], gate['metrics']
a = gc['allocation']
node, gpu = gc['node'], a['cuda_visible_devices']
require(parent['_meta']['command'] == expected and parent['_meta']['exit_code'] == 86
    and c['name'] == parent_name and c['pbs_jobid'] == job and c['scenes'] == ['FloorPlan315']
    and c['concurrencies'] == [6] and c['timeout_seconds'] == 1600 and c['g01_partition'] == 'train'
    and c['quota_plan_reference'] == old_plan and c['seed'] == 0 and c['field_of_view'] == 60
    and pm.get('kind') == 'g01_parallel_collection' and pm.get('status') == 'blocked_by_render_gate'
    and pm.get('exit_code') == 86 and pm.get('black_frame_detected') is True
    and not pm.get('error') and not pm.get('errors') and pm.get('cleanup_errors') == []
    and all(pm.get(k) == [] for k in ('scene_runs', 'started_shards', 'stages', 'admission_final',
                                    'unfinished_run_names', 'stop_reasons'))
    and pm.get('acceptance_passed') is False, 'Parent has business work, nonblack error or uncertain cleanup')
require(pm['gate']['run_name'] == gate_name and pm['gate']['source']['sha256'] == gref['sha256']
    and pm['gate']['source']['metrics_sha256'] == gref['metrics_sha256'] and pm['gate']['exit_code'] == 86,
    'Parent gate binding changed')
require({part.split('/')[0] for part in f['exec_host'].split('+')} == {node}
    and parent['_meta']['host'] == gate['_meta']['host'] == c['node'] == node
    and gc['pbs_jobid'] == a['pbs_jobid'] == job and a['cuda_driver_uuids'] == [gpu]
    and c['parent_cuda_visible_devices'] == gpu and a['cpu_affinity'] == c['cpu_affinity']
    and len(a['cpu_affinity']) == len(set(a['cpu_affinity'])) == 12
    and gc['resolution'] == 255 and gc['segmentation'] is True
    and gc['timeout_seconds'] == c['gate_timeout_seconds'] == 120
    and gate['_meta']['exit_code'] == gm.get('exit_code') == 86 and gm.get('passed') is False
    and gm.get('black_frame_detected') is True and gm.get('errors') == gm.get('cleanup_errors') == []
    and gm.get('expected_gpu_count') == gm.get('completed_gpu_count') == 1
    and len(gm['devices']) == len(a['devices']) == 1, 'Original native gate identity differs')
ob = gm['devices'][0]['observation']
require(gm['devices'][0]['worker_error'] is None and not ob.get('error') and not ob.get('cleanup_error')
    and ob['gpu_identity'] == a['devices'][0] and ob['gpu_identity']['gpu_uuid'] == gpu
    and ob['node'] == node and [v['stage'] for v in ob['captures']] == ['after_constructor', 'after_Pass'],
    'Native observations incomplete')
for stage in ('constructor', 'Pass'):
    require(any(v['stage'] == stage and v['fresh_main_rgb_payloads'] > 0 and v['cached_metadata'] is False
                for v in ob['wire_packets']), 'Missing original fresh wire payload')
captures = []
for capture in ob['captures']:
    path = Path(capture['png']['path']).resolve()
    require(path.parent == r / 'logs/runs' / gate_name / 'render_gate', 'Original capture path differs')
    rr = ref(path)
    require(rr['sha256'] == capture['png']['sha256'] and capture['valid_shape'] is True
        and capture['shape'] == [255, 255, 3] and capture['dtype'] == 'uint8'
        and capture['action_success'] is True and not capture['error_message'] and capture['black'] is True
        and capture['nonzero_rgb_values'] == capture['min_rgb'] == capture['max_rgb'] == 0,
        'Original native black capture invalid')
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(path.read_bytes())) as image:
        require(image.mode == 'RGB' and image.size == (255, 255) and image.getextrema() == ((0, 0),) * 3,
                'Decoded original capture is not completely black')
    captures.append(rr)
proof = {'eligible_proven_black_gate_retry': True, 'job_id': job, 'native_kind': pm['kind'],
    'original_payload': ref(pp), 'original_job_script': ref(sp), 'original_receipt': ref(rp),
    'original_command_unchanged': expected, 'pbs_accounting': aref, 'source_results': [pref, gref],
    'node': node, 'gpu_uuid': gpu, 'captures': captures}
old_path = r / old_plan['file']
require(ref(old_path) == old_plan and not old_path.stat().st_mode & 0o222, 'Original quota changed')
plan = json.loads(old_path.read_bytes())
require(plan['parent_run_name'] == parent_name, 'Original quota parent changed')
new_plan = dict(plan, parent_run_name=next_name)
require({k: v for k, v in new_plan.items() if k != 'parent_run_name'} ==
        {k: v for k, v in plan.items() if k != 'parent_run_name'}, 'Scientific quota values changed')
new_path = r / 'configs/gen_train_look_first_unit_01_retry1_quota.json'
with new_path.open('x') as handle:
    json.dump(new_plan, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    handle.write('\n')
new_path.chmod(0o444)
new_ref = ref(new_path)
command = list(expected)
for flag, value in [('--name', next_name), ('--quota-plan', new_ref['file']), ('--quota-plan-sha256', new_ref['sha256'])]:
    command[command.index(flag) + 1] = value
b.same_retry_command(r, expected, command, parent_name, next_name)
metrics = {'strict_black_gate_proof': proof, 'technical_retry_plan_ready': True, 'original_plan': old_plan,
    'new_plan': new_ref, 'only_plan_value_changed': 'parent_run_name', 'all_other_plan_values_equal': True,
    'producer_command': command, 'requested_wall_seconds': 1630, 'retry_of': job,
    'scope': 'Exact original FP315 scientific/quota settings; opening native black; no submission'}
with (r / 'results' / (name + '.json')).open('x') as handle:
    json.dump({'metrics': metrics, 'config': {'name': name}, 'sources': [pref, gref, aref]}, handle, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    handle.write('\n')
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: ' + json.dumps(metrics, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
